about: Demo installation for the flightsim.to screenshots of FS Organizer. Every add-on, studio and airline is fictional; the only real package names are the simulator's own, in simulator.defaultPackages.
dateRule: Every date in this folder is written as if today were anchorDate. Shift journal timestamps, sidecar 'quarantined' values, file modification times and the loading report's TimeUTC by the whole number of days between anchorDate and the day the demo is generated.

drive.how: subst F: <demo root>\drive, so every path the screens print starts with F:\

secondProfile.note: inactive profile, both folders created empty

paths.simulatorUserFolder: demo/simulator/Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 -> stands in for %APPDATA%\Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 (Steam edition layout)

studios.name: Cobalt Ridge Simulations
studios.makes: piston GA aircraft, a flying-club livery pack, a tyre mod

studios.name: Fernhill Simulations
studios.makes: utility turboprops and a cockpit-lighting mod

studios.name: Paperwing Studio
studios.makes: liveries for fictional airlines, one wing mod

studios.name: Lanternfish Design
studios.makes: night lighting for airports and cabins

studios.name: Pinecrest Traffic Works
studios.makes: AI traffic models, liveries, schedules and an injector

studios.name: Vireo Avionics
studios.makes: an EFB, a hub program, navigation data, an avionics mod

studios.name: Brightwater Simworks
studios.makes: a bridge program and camera presets

studios.name: Stratoform
studios.makes: cloud textures and a live-weather engine
